verdict.rationale: Instinct is an autonomous personal assistant that runs tasks and proactive follow-ups, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no version history, review step or rollback for automations. Revoking access and deleting indexed data are separate data controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
